manifest.name: dsh-rewind-compact
manifest.description: Rewind-compact plugin bundle for the DeepSeek Harness: rewind the conversation to a chosen turn boundary and summarize one side as a five-field scaffold.

bundle.text:
# rewind-compact bundle patch layer. Entries target the harness's own service
# entries (compaction, sessions, agents, commands, tools, skills, permissions).
# Never override or disable dsh-* entries; only add new ids under this bundle.
- insert:
    - id: rewind-compact/entry
      name: dsh-rewind-compact
      config: {}

readme.text: Plugin bundle for the DeepSeek Harness (`dsh`): rewind the conversation to a chosen completed-turn boundary and summarize one side of that boundary as the mechanical **five-field scaffold** — the v1 summary; LLM prose is deferred and not shipped. The other side survives verbatim. The pre-rewind session always remains resumable by id — the discarded side is never lost.

- TUI command `/rewind-compact [turn] [after|before]` — fast path; no arguments points at the picker. The picker lists **only completed turns still present in the current context** — a turn whose messages were compacted away (shadowed by a compaction checkpoint or replaced by a compact summary) is never advertised, its preview is never system-notice or summary text, and the per-turn files-changed count is computed over the same in-context view (RWC-019). Explicit turn numbers — the fast path and the tool's `point` — still resolve out-of-context turns (recovery path).

**Descoped for v1 (RWC-018):** the Esc-Esc picker mode is not active on dsh-tui 0.17.0. A profile bundle is a backend activation; the TUI dispatcher reads only its host-mediated `DecisionEvents` registry, and a backend cannot register there. The TUI **command** and the model tool both work; the picker needs a native TUI plugin or a harness bridge (see `docs/tickets/RWC-018-tui-decision-event-host.md`).
- Model-invoked tool `rewind_compact(point, mode, rewind)` — `rewind: true` forks a new session and requires direct human authority in the current turn (fails closed headless/sdk/goal-round). `rewind: false` is retired in v1: it returns a documented unsupported result and never touches the transcript.
- Skill `rewind-compact` — when to propose, tool rules, summary format, post-fork etiquette.

Profiles declare ordered `dsh.profile.bundles`; after a successful package
operation DSH adds the new bundle dependency to that list automatically.
Refreshing an already-installed `file:` dependency needs `remove` + `add`
(see TESTING.md).

The package is distributed by **path or tarball**; `private: true` is deliberate
— it is not published to npm.

- **Path**: `dsh plugin --profile <name> add --offline "file:$PWD"` (above).
- **Tarball**: `npm pack` in this checkout produces
  `dsh-rewind-compact-0.1.0.tgz`; install it with
  `dsh plugin --profile <name> add --offline "file:./dsh-rewind-compact-0.1.0.tgz"`.
  The `files` allowlist ships `lib/`, `skill/`, `cordis.patch.yml`, `README.md`,
  `LICENSE`, and `COPYING`; tests, scripts, docs, and `SPEC.md` stay in the
  repository.
- **Git**: not a supported install path. There is no build step (`prepare` is
  absent), and a git install would need `prepare` + `allowBuilds` plus a pinned
  commit SHA to be reproducible — use the path or tarball forms instead.

`lib/index.js` reads `skill/rewind-compact/SKILL.md` at import time, so that
file must be in the installed artifact; it is covered by `files` and appears in
`npm pack --dry-run`. The harness gate remains `engines.dsh` (below).

Declared harness line: **`dsh >=0.2.1-rc.2 <0.3.0-0`** (`engines.dsh`, mirrored
by the `@deepseek-ai/dsh-*` peer ranges) — verified on `0.2.1-rc.2`. Older
`0.1.x` / `0.2.0-rc.x` builds are not supported, and the `<0.3.0-0` upper bound
excludes `0.3.0` prereleases (`0.3.0-rc.x`) as well as `0.3.0`. `npm run check`
enforces the line and probes the 0.2.1 contracts (Session v4, `createAgent`
options, `compactRegion`) against **this checkout's** `lib/`; see
`docs/HARNESS-CONTRACTS.md` for the compatibility matrix and anchors.

| Surface | Where it works |
|---|---|
| Esc-Esc rewind picker (after mode) | **Descoped for v1** (RWC-018): backend bundle cannot register host DecisionEvents; use the TUI command/tool |
| `/rewind-compact` command | profiles providing the `commands` service (base-backed: web, TUI, headless, SDK); else skipped with one log line |
| `rewind_compact` tool | every profile that loads the bundle (model-invoked) |
| `rewind-compact` skill | profiles providing the `skills` service (base-backed: web, TUI, headless, SDK); else skipped with one log line |

Only `tools` and `agents` are hard requirements. `sdk-minimal` deliberately
ships neither `commands` nor `skills`, so there the bundle still loads and
registers the tool (the TUI decision subscriptions are inert without a TUI),
logging one skip line per absent surface.

Headless/sdk: the rewind path fails closed (no direct human input in a goal-round turn); the retired in-place path returns `applied: false` and changes nothing.

- **Scaffold-only summaries.** Every shipped path delivers the mechanical five-field scaffold as the summary and reports `hybrid: false`; LLM prose through `ctx.compaction` is a v2 target, not shipped (ADR RWC-015 D2/D3).
- **In-place compaction is retired.** `rewind: false` (or omitted) returns `ok: false`, `applied: false`, `reason: "in_place_retired"`, and a note pointing at the fork path. It never appends, never calls `compactRegion`, and leaves the transcript byte-identical — this is not a working compact path.
- **Rewind requires direct human authority.** Through the tool it requires a user-sourced message in the current open turn and fails closed without a human (`REWIND_COMPACT_APPROVAL_REQUIRED`). There is no plugin-authored decision prompt; if the model is unsure, it asks the user in conversation before calling.
- **TUI offers after mode only.** Before mode remains on the `/rewind-compact` command and the tool (ADR D5); a stale before-mode done event gets an explicit error toast.
- **No file revert.** The plugin reports which files changed after the boundary but never restores them (deferred v2).
- **Fork metadata and title.** The child is created with `meta {cwd, parentS

- **Compaction (v2 seam only)** — `ctx.compaction.compactRegion(start, end, agent, signal)` (CompactionEngine contract, `dsh-compaction-basic`) is the only permitted seam for a future LLM-generated summary. v1 never calls it: the in-place path is retired (ADR D2) and forked children have no open turn, so every shipped summary is the five-field scaffold (`hybrid: false`). If hybrid returns, the scaffold must be delivered inside a closed, balanced range as its final message; the four-argument signature takes no instructions argument. The pre-rewind session is never appended to or truncated.
- **Rewind/fork** — the TUI's fork-at-boundary recipe (`@deepseek-harness-tui/dsh-tui/lib/types/dsh-adapter/channel/session-rewind.js`): cancel agent → wait `turn/end` → walk back to enclosing `turn/start`, cut at `turnStart.seq - 1` → `agents.create({sessionId: SessionId(randomUUID()), seed, meta: {cwd, parentSession, isSeeded: true, agentPreset?}, inheritedEventCount: seed.length, setup})`. Never `sessions.fork()`; never mutate the pre-rewind session.
